newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, barges trade $204.50 - $207.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, barges trade $204.50 - $207.

text.p: NWE gasoline physical and swaps prices were almost unchanged on Monday, traders said.
One prompt physical Eurograde barge of ex-storage material changed hands at $204.50 a tonne fob ARA, and pure refinery-origin material piece was confirmed traded at $207.
This latter number was $1 above the best offer at the time.
"The buyer wanted the numbers higher," one dealer said of that deal, and assessed the market for running refinery barrels at $205/$206.
Some dealers thought $206 had also traded, but this could not be confirmed.
Cargoes were quiet and dealers were awaiting direction from the U.S. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
